name: Alphalink
summary: Melbourne dialup + ADSL ISP ('Cheaper Net, Better Net', Alphalink (Australia) Pty Ltd); folded into Chariot Internet, alphalink.net.au redirecting to chariot.net.au by 2009.

names.name: Alphalink
source: 2008 site title: 'Alphalink (Australia) Pty Ltd - Cheaper Net, Better Net'

events.details: Melbourne dialup ISP, trading as Alphalink (Australia) Pty Ltd; commenced operations 7 January 1997. Earliest Wayback capture 22 Dec 1997.

Retail content last seen 2008; alphalink.net.au redirecting (301) to chariot.net.au by Sep 2009 — customers folded into Chariot Internet. Prior 'ABN cancelled 2017' record was misattributed to an unrelated 2022 company (ALPHALINK TECHNOLOGY PTY LTD, ACN 663 309 500) and has been removed.
